title: Japanese Town Struggles with Violent Monkeys
paragraphs: In cartoons, monkeys are often seen as cute, cuddly and perhaps a little naughty.
But residents of a town in Kanagawa probably wouldn't describe the monkeys there as cute and cuddly — but they're certainly very naughty!
Yugawara has been struggling with a violent group of Japanese macaques. The town — which is popular for its hot springs — has had a large population of monkeys since the 1950s.
But in recent years, one group of about 20 monkeys has been causing a lot of problems.
There have been many reports of monkeys attacking people, stealing things and more.
In 2025, there were more than 6,000 incidents caused by this group of monkeys, according to SoraNews24.
And it looks like it's getting worse. In September, a man was bitten by one of the monkeys. This was the first reported incident of a monkey biting a human in Yugawara, SoraNews24 reports.
Experts aren't sure why this is happening, but some believe there must have been an event that caused the monkeys to become more violent.

Residents will likely not be seeing a decrease in monkeys on their streets any time soon, either — because it's thought that many monkeys have moved from their usual trees to empty houses closer to the town.
The town's monkey control center is now tracking two of the monkeys in the group, and it's hoped that this will help them notice violent behavior more quickly, and send out people to help.
And perhaps they could show the monkeys some cartoons, too — that might help them learn how to be cute and cuddly!
